spells.name: Bless

fields.Material: Holy water; polluted water for the reverse

effect: Friendly recipients gain +1 morale and +1 to hit.
conditions: Recipients must not already be in melee.
exceptions: Reverse: curse gives enemies −1 morale and −1 to hit.

spells.name: Command
effect: Issue one clear, unambiguous word in a language the target understands. It obeys as well as it can.
conditions: Intelligence 13+ or 6+ HD/levels allows one saving throw versus magic.
“Die” produces a one-round faint, not death.
exceptions: Undead are unaffected.

spells.name: Create Water

fields.Material: A drop of water; dust for the reverse

effect: Produces 4 gallons of clean drinking water per caster level.
conditions: Cannot create water inside a living creature.
exceptions: Reverse destroys the same quantity without mist, steam or other residue.

spells.name: Cure Light Wounds
effect: Heals 1d8 points of injury.
conditions: The reverse causes 1d8 damage; touching an unwilling victim requires a melee hit roll.
exceptions: Does not heal noncorporeal or nonliving creatures, or creatures harmed only by iron, silver or magical weapons.

spells.name: Detect Evil

fields.Material: Holy or unholy symbol held before the caster

effect: Detects evil emanations from creatures and objects in the direction faced.
exceptions: Does not flag an ordinary trap or an unintelligent dangerous animal merely because it threatens someone.
Reverse detects good.

spells.name: Detect Magic
effect: Detects magical radiation in the direction faced; caster may turn 60° per round.
conditions: Blocked by at least 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of solid metal, or 3 feet of solid wood.

spells.name: Light

fields.Saving throw: Special if cast on a creature

effect: Creates torch-bright illumination. The caster can extinguish it with a word.
conditions: Requires line of sight or an unobstructed spell path.
A creature’s successful save places the light immediately behind it instead.
exceptions: Reverse produces darkness for half the light duration.

spells.name: Protection from Evil

fields.Material: Holy water circle, or burning incense; reverse uses blood or smoldering dung

effect: Evil attackers suffer −2 to hit; recipient gains +2 on saves against their attacks.
A 1-foot barrier prevents bodily contact by the enchanted, conjured and summoned creatures described in the source.
exceptions: Reverse protects against good while continuing to exclude enchanted evil creatures.

spells.name: Remove Fear
effect: Grants +4 on saving throws against magical fear for 1 turn.
For existing fear, permits a new save with a bonus equal to caster level.
conditions: Touching an unwilling recipient requires a hit roll.
exceptions: Reverse causes flight for 1 round/level. The two forms counter one another.

spells.name: Resist Cold
effect: Makes 0°F tolerable without clothing. Against stronger cold, grants +3 to saves and reduces damage to half on a failed save or a quarter on success.

spells.name: Sanctuary

fields.Material: Holy/unholy symbol and a small silver mirror

effect: An attacker must save versus magic to attack the protected creature; failure makes it ignore that creature and attack another.
conditions: The protected cleric may take no offensive action. Nonattack spells, including healing, remain possible.
exceptions: Area attacks such as fireball still work.

spells.name: Hold Person

fields.Material: A small straight piece of iron

effect: Immobilizes eligible humans and humanoids.
conditions: Three targets save normally; two save at −1 each; a single target saves at −2.
Eligible types: brownies, dryads, dwarves, elves, gnolls, gnomes, goblins, half-elves, halflings, half-orcs, hobgoblins, humans, kobolds, lizard men, nixies, orcs, pixies, sprites and troglodytes.

spells.name: Silence, 15′ Radius

fields.Saving throw: Special if cast on an unwilling creature

effect: Stops sound throughout the sphere, preventing conversation and spell casting as described in the source.
conditions: May be centered in air, on an object, or on a creature; a creature carries it along.
exceptions: An unwilling creature may save; success centers the effect about 1 foot behind it.

spells.name: Resist Fire
effect: Makes boiling heat comfortable. Stronger or magical fire allows +3 to saves and deals half damage on a failed save, one-quarter on success.

spells.name: Entangle
effect: Plants in the area twist around creatures and hold them fast.
conditions: A successful save allows movement at half speed for the duration.

spells.name: Faerie Fire
effect: Outlines creatures or objects in a harmless glow; attacks against outlined creatures gain +2 to hit.
conditions: Completely outline one subject before starting the next.
Outlined invisible subjects become visible: 8″ away in darkness, 4″ if the viewer is near bright light.

spells.name: Invisibility to Animals
effect: Makes the recipient undetectable to normal animals with Intelligence below 6, including giant varieties.
exceptions: Animals with magical powers or abilities can still perceive the recipient.

spells.name: Locate Animals
effect: Reveals direction and distance of the chosen kind of animal in the detection path.
conditions: Concentrate on one animal type and face only one direction during each round.

spells.name: Pass without Trace

fields.Material: Mistletoe leaf and a pine/evergreen sprig; burn the leaf and scatter its powdered ashes

effect: Recipient leaves neither footprints nor scent while crossing terrain.
conditions: The travelled area radiates magic for 6–36 turns after passage.

spells.name: Predict Weather
effect: Accurately forecasts sky conditions, temperature and precipitation for the stated area and time.

spells.name: Purify Water
effect: Makes contaminated water fit to drink.
exceptions: Reverse contaminates water and can spoil holy or unholy water.

spells.name: Shillelagh

fields.Material: Oaken club, mistletoe and a shamrock leaf

effect: Caster’s club gains +1 to hit and deals 2d4 damage to up-to-man-sized foes, 1d4+1 to larger foes.
conditions: The druid must wield the club.

spells.name: Barkskin

fields.Material: Mistletoe and a handful of oak bark

effect: Improves armor class by one place and adds +1 to saving throws against attack forms other than magic.

spells.name: Cure Light Wounds
effect: Heals 1d8 injury points, following the cleric version’s restrictions.
conditions: Reverse causes 1d8 damage; an unwilling touch requires a melee hit roll.
exceptions: Does not heal noncorporeal or nonliving creatures, or those harmed only by iron, silver or magical weapons.

spells.name: Burning Hands

fields.Area: 3-foot flames in a roughly 120° forward arc

effect: Flame deals 1 damage per caster level to creatures in the arc and ignites flammable materials.
conditions: Thumbs must touch and fingers must spread to form the fan.

spells.name: Charm Person

fields.Renewal saves: Int ≤3: every 3 months; 4–6: 2 months; 7–9: 1 month; 10–12: 3 weeks; 13–14: 2 weeks; 15–16: 1 week; 17: 3 days; 18: 2 days; 19+: 1 day.

effect: The subject treats the caster as a trusted friend and ally rather than as a master with absolute control.
conditions: No language knowledge is gained. New saves occur at intervals determined by Intelligence (source table, p.55).
Eligible types: brownies, dwarves, elves, gnolls, gnomes, goblins, half-elves, halflings, half-orcs, hobgoblins, humans, kobolds, lizard men, nixies, orcs, pixies, sprites and troglodytes.
exceptions: An overt attempt by the caster to harm the subject breaks the charm. Dispel magic can end it.
The spell does not compel suicidal obedience.

spells.name: Comprehend Languages

fields.Area: One written item or speaking creature
fields.Material: A pinch of soot and a few salt grains

effect: Understands otherwise unknown writing or a speaker’s language while touching the item or creature.
exceptions: Does not grant speech or writing in that language, or decipher magical writing.
Reverse prevents comprehension or counters this spell.

spells.name: Dancing Lights
effect: Creates 1–4 torch/lanternlike lights, glowing spheres, or one dim humanoid light shape.
Lights move as directed without sustained concentration.
conditions: They disappear if they exceed range or duration.

spells.name: Detect Magic
effect: Detects magic in the directed path, following the cleric version except for the header differences.
conditions: Stone 1 foot thick, solid metal 1 inch thick, or solid wood 3 feet thick blocks detection.
Caster may turn 60° per round.

spells.name: Feather Fall

fields.Material: A small feather or piece of down on caster’s person

effect: Slows free fall to 12 feet/segment; landing during the spell causes no damage.
conditions: Weight limit: 2,000 gp weight + 2,000 gp weight/level.
Normal falling resumes when the spell ends.
exceptions: Works on free-falling or propelled objects, including missiles; not on a sword blow or a charging creature.

spells.name: Friends

fields.Material: Chalk/flour, lampblack/soot and vermilion applied to the face

effect: Against failed saves, caster gains 2d4 apparent Charisma and recipients want to help. Successful saves instead produce irritation and a temporary 1d4 Charisma reduction.
exceptions: No effect on animal Intelligence or lower.

spells.name: Hold Portal
effect: Magically holds a door, gate or similar portal shut. It can still be broken or battered down.
conditions: Knock or dispel magic negates it; a magic-user at least four levels above the caster can open it at will.
exceptions: Extradimensional creatures can shatter the hold.
OCR discrepancy: the paragraph reads 2 feet/level while the header reads 2″/level. The scan must be visually checked; ask the referee.

spells.name: Jump

fields.Material: One grasshopper hind leg for each leap; break it when leaping

effect: Allows a leap of up to 30 feet forward, or 10 feet backward/upward.
One leap initially, plus one for each three caster levels beyond 1st.
exceptions: Does not guarantee safe landing or a successful grip at the destination.

spells.name: Light

fields.Saving throw: Special if cast on a creature

effect: Creates torch-bright illumination; follows the cleric version with this card’s header differences.
conditions: Requires sight or an unobstructed path. A creature’s successful save moves the effect immediately behind it.

spells.name: Magic Missile
effect: Each missile automatically hits for 1d4+1 damage.
One missile at 1st level; gain another for every two caster levels (2 at 3rd, 3 at 5th, and so on).
conditions: Multiple missiles may strike one creature or be divided among creatures in the target area.

spells.name: Mending

fields.Material: Two small magnets/lodestones or two burrs

effect: Repairs small breaks: a single metal break, multiple ceramic/wood fractures, or a hole in a leather container.
exceptions: Cannot repair any magical item.

spells.name: Message
effect: A pointed-at creature hears the caster’s whisper along a straight path; it may whisper a reply if time remains.
conditions: Requires an open, unobstructed path. The message and reply must fit the duration.

spells.name: Read Magic

fields.Material: A clear crystal or mineral prism, not consumed

effect: Deciphers magical writing; the caster can later reread that particular inscription without casting again.
exceptions: Reading normally does not activate the magic, but a cursed scroll can be an exception.
Reverse makes writing unreadable even to read magic until expiry or dispelling; it uses dirt and water.

spells.name: Shield
effect: Negates magic missile attacks. Gives AC 2 versus hand-hurled missiles, AC 3 versus small device-launched missiles and AC 4 against other attacks.
Adds +1 to saves against basically frontal attacks.
conditions: Every benefit applies only to attacks from the caster’s front.

spells.name: Shocking Grasp
effect: Caster’s touch discharges 1d8 + 1/level electrical damage.
conditions: A conductor touching the target can deliver the charge.
exceptions: An opponent touching the caster does not discharge it.

spells.name: Sleep

fields.Material: Fine sand, rose petals or a live cricket

effect: Puts eligible creatures into deep sleep; the number affected depends on their hit dice (distribution table on printed p.68).
conditions: Slapping or injury awakens a subject; noise does not. Waking someone takes a full round.
Affected-number table remains unextracted pending visual verification.
exceptions: Undead and creatures specifically immune in the Monster Manual are unaffected.

spells.name: Spider Climb

fields.Material: Recipient eats a drop of bitumen and a live spider

effect: Allows movement on walls and ceilings at 3″.
conditions: Hands and feet must be bare.
Objects lighter than 50 gp weight stick to hands/feet; this makes spell casting virtually impossible.

spells.name: Change Self
effect: Alters apparent form, clothing and equipment: up to 1 foot shorter or taller, varied build, and a generally man-shaped bipedal appearance.

spells.name: Color Spray

fields.Material: A pinch each of red, yellow and blue powder or sand

effect: Affects 1–6 creatures with a spray of colors: subjects no higher than the caster fall unconscious for 2d4 rounds; 1–2 levels/HD higher are blinded for 1d4 rounds; 3+ higher are stunned for 2d4 segments.
conditions: Creatures above caster level, and those with 6+ levels/HD, receive a save.
The source states a capacity of one level/hit die per caster level; consult the referee for applying this alongside the higher-HD results.
Wedge dimensions are not extracted because OCR is ambiguous.

spells.name: Detect Illusion

fields.Area: Line of sight, 1″ wide and 1″ long/level

effect: Reveals an illusion as unreal.
conditions: To give another creature this sight, the caster must touch it with both hands while it looks at the illusion.

spells.name: Gaze Reflection
effect: Creates a reflective surface in the air before the caster, turning a gaze attack back on a gazer that looks at the caster.

spells.name: Hypnotism
effect: Makes failed-save subjects receptive to a subsequent spoken suggestion, following the referenced suggestion rules.
conditions: Give the suggestion after casting. The caster does not know whether hypnotism worked until then.
The suggestion itself is spoken urging, not another spell.

spells.name: Wall of Fog

fields.Area: Cube, 2″ per side per caster level
fields.Material: A pinch of split dried peas

effect: Creates mist obscuring normal sight and infravision beyond 2 feet.
conditions: A strong breeze can disperse it.

spells.name: Blindness
effect: A failed save leaves the subject blind, perceiving only grayness.
exceptions: Ordinary cure spells do not remove it; the caster or dispel magic can end the effect.

spells.name: Blur
effect: Shifting outline gives incoming melee/missile attacks −4 on the first attempt and −2 on later attempts. Adds +1 to saves against direct magical attacks.

spells.name: Dispel Magic
effect: Cancels spells on creatures/objects or counters casting in the area. Chance: 50%, +5% per caster level above the original caster, −2% per level below.
Automatically dispels the caster’s own magic.
conditions: Potions can be destroyed and count as 12th level for this check.
exceptions: Does not remove the enchantment from scrolls, rings, wands, weapons, armor and other specially enchanted items.

spells.name: Prayer

fields.Material: Silver holy symbol, prayer beads or similar religious item

effect: Friendly attack/save rolls gain +1; corresponding enemy rolls take −1.
conditions: After casting, the cleric may act normally without continuing to chant.

spells.name: Heat Metal

fields.Area: Metal of 1 man-sized creature/level, or 500 gp weight/level

effect: Heats iron, steel or other ferrous metal. Round 1/7: uncomfortably warm; rounds 2/6: 1d4 damage; rounds 3–5: 2d4 damage per round.
Searing metal can disable exposed hands/feet, head or body; the source gives different recovery periods.
conditions: Nearby combustible clothing/materials can ignite and cause further damage.
exceptions: Fire resistance, protection from fire, water/snow immersion or cold/ice storm negates the heat. Reverse chill metal has its own damage/disability table; resist cold or great heat counters it.
Disability recovery periods and the reverse chill metal damage/disability table are not fully extracted; consult PHB p.56 before applying them.

spells.name: Invisibility

fields.Material: An eyelash enclosed in gum arabic

effect: Hides the recipient and gear from normal sight and infravision.
conditions: Does not silence noise. Any attack ends the invisibility, allowing the initial attack from hiding.
Allies cannot see the recipient unless they can perceive invisibility.
exceptions: Highly intelligent creatures with 10+ HD/levels or equivalent may detect invisible subjects.

spells.name: Knock
effect: Opens stuck, held, locked, barred or secret doors, locked containers, shackles and chains. Handles two closure functions per casting.
conditions: Wizard lock is suspended for 1 turn rather than dispelled.
A locked, barred and held door needs two castings.
exceptions: Does not lift a portcullis or similar barrier.

spells.name: Levitate

fields.Material: A leather loop, or gold wire formed into a cup with a long shank

effect: Raises the caster vertically at 20 feet/round, or another recipient at up to 10 feet/round.
conditions: Does not grant horizontal propulsion, though the recipient may push against a surface.
Caster may cancel the effect; an unwilling creature may save.

spells.name: Web

fields.Saving throw: At −2; escape or reduced restraint on success
fields.Area: Up to 8 cubic ″; at least 1″ thick

effect: Sticky strands must anchor between at least two opposed points.
Strength below 13 cannot self-escape; Strength 13–17 breaks 1 foot/turn; 18+ breaks 1 foot/round. Very strong, huge subjects can break 1 foot/segment.
conditions: Each turn trapped brings a cumulative 5% suffocation risk.
A successful save allows a jump free if space permits; otherwise web strength is reduced (fraction awaits visual verification).
exceptions: Fire burns webs away in 1 round, dealing 2d4 damage to those still caught. Range is withheld because OCR is ambiguous.

spells.name: Dispel Magic
effect: Uses the cleric dispel procedure: 50% base chance, +5% per level above the original caster or −2% per level below; automatic against the caster’s own spells.
conditions: Can destroy potions, treating them as 12th level.
exceptions: Does not remove permanent enchantment from specially magical items such as weapons, armor or rings.

spells.name: Fireball

fields.Components: V, S in OCR header; material specified in prose
fields.Area: 2″-radius sphere; volume conforms to surrounding space
fields.Material: A tiny ball of bat guano and sulphur

effect: Deals 1d6 fire damage per caster level; ignites combustibles and melts soft metals.
The projectile bursts at the chosen point, or sooner if it strikes a material obstruction.
conditions: The blast can spread through confined space to fill its volume. Objects exposed to the effect may require saves; items carried by a creature that saves are unaffected.
exceptions: Wands use 6d6, staves 8d6, and scrolls 5–10 dice as specified in the description. Header/material mismatch requires a visual check.

spells.name: Fly
effect: Grants flight at 12″, halved while ascending and doubled when diving.
conditions: The referee rolls the extra duration secretly, so the caster does not know exactly when it expires.

spells.name: Haste
effect: Doubles movement and attack rates, and negates slow.
conditions: Nearest eligible creatures receive the effect first.
Ages recipients through accelerated metabolism.
exceptions: Does not accelerate spell casting.

spells.name: Lightning Bolt

fields.Material: Fur and an amber, crystal or glass rod

effect: Deals 1d6 electrical damage per caster level, ignites combustibles and can damage doors, stone and soft metals.
Choose the stroke’s starting range and forked or single form.
conditions: If a nonconducting obstruction prevents the full stroke, it rebounds toward the caster to complete its length.
The single stroke’s width is withheld because OCR is ambiguous.

spells.name: Suggestion

fields.Material: Snake’s tongue plus honeycomb or sweet oil

effect: Influences a subject through a short suggestion phrased as a reasonable course of action.
conditions: Target must understand the language. The referee may penalize saves against especially reasonable suggestions.
exceptions: An obviously self-destructive request negates the spell. Undead are immune.

spells.name: Tenser's Floating Disc
effect: Creates a level concave carrying disc about 3 feet above the ground. It normally follows 6 feet behind the caster, or moves as commanded within range at 6″.
conditions: When range or duration is exceeded, the disc vanishes and its load falls to the surface below.

spells.name: Unseen Servant

fields.Material: String and a bit of wood

effect: Invisible force performs simple household tasks, including opening ordinary doors and carrying light objects.
Carries up to 200 gp weight, or moves up to 400 gp weight over a relatively frictionless surface.
exceptions: Cannot fight. It is dispellable and vanishes after 6 points of magical damage.

spells.name: Augury

fields.Material: Gem-inlaid sticks, dragon bones or similar tokens; the tea-leaf method also consumes a crushed pearl worth at least 100 gp

effect: Seeks whether an action within the next 3 turns will benefit or harm the party.
conditions: Base accuracy is 70% + 1% per caster level; the referee may adjust for circumstances.

spells.name: Slow Poison

fields.Material: Holy/unholy symbol and a garlic bud, crushed and smeared on the victim’s bare feet

effect: Delays venom’s effects, including temporarily restoring an apparently dead victim treated within caster level turns after poisoning.
conditions: Victim loses 1 hp per turn, but cannot fall below 1 hp during the spell.
exceptions: Does not neutralize the poison; a lasting remedy is still needed.

spells.name: Cure Blindness
effect: Permanently cures most forms of blindness.
conditions: Reverse cause blindness requires a successful touch; a successful save negates it.
exceptions: The illusionist Blindness spell explicitly resists cure spells; its caster or dispel magic must remove it (p.95).

spells.name: Cure Disease
effect: Cures most diseases, including parasitic, bacterial and viral afflictions. Recovery takes from 1 turn to 1 week, depending on the disease and its progress.
conditions: Reverse cause disease requires a touch and failed save. Symptoms begin after 1d6 turns, costing 1 hp/turn and 1 Strength/hour until both reach 10% of their original values.

spells.name: Cure Serious Wounds
effect: Heals 2d8+1 injury points. The reverse inflicts the same damage after a successful touch.
exceptions: Does not affect noncorporeal or nonliving creatures, or those harmed only by iron, silver or magical weapons.

spells.name: Cure Critical Wounds
effect: Heals 3d8+3 injury points. The reverse inflicts the same damage after a successful touch.
exceptions: Does not affect noncorporeal or nonliving creatures, or those harmed only by iron, silver or magical weapons.

spells.name: Heal
effect: Cures all diseases and blindness, dispels feeblemind, and heals injury damage except for 1d4 hp remaining unhealed.
conditions: Reverse harm causes disease and leaves the successfully touched victim with only 1d4 hp.
exceptions: Does not affect noncorporeal or nonliving creatures, or those harmed only by iron, silver or magical weapons.

spells.name: Neutralize Poison

fields.Saving throw: None; reverse allows a poison save
fields.Area: Touched creature, or 1 cubic foot of substance per 2 levels

effect: Detoxifies venom in the touched creature or substance.
conditions: Touching an unwilling opponent or its poisoned weapon requires a melee hit.
Reverse poison requires a successful touch and kills a victim that fails its saving throw versus poison.
exceptions: Newly generated venom is unaffected; a venom-producing creature or object is not permanently rendered harmless.

spells.name: Remove Curse
effect: Removes a curse from a person, object or similar affliction.
conditions: Bestow curse requires a successful touch and failed save. Its random effects lower one ability to 3 (50%), give −4 to hit and saves (25%), or give a 50% chance each turn to drop held items/do nothing (25%).
exceptions: Does not remove the curse from an enchanted shield, weapon or armor, though it usually lets the afflicted person discard that item.

spells.name: Raise Dead
effect: Restores life to a dwarf, gnome, half-elf, halfling or human dead for no more than 1 day per caster level.
conditions: The body must be whole; missing parts remain missing. A Constitution-based survival check is required.
The raised person is helpless and needs 1 full day of bed rest for each day spent dead.
Reverse slay living permits a save; success still inflicts 2d8+1 damage.
exceptions: Newly made undead other than skeletons can be affected within the same time limit and survival rules.
A good cleric’s use of slay living carries strict evil-target and necessity requirements described in the source.

spells.name: Word Of Recall
effect: Instantly and safely returns the cleric to a specifically designated, well-known sanctuary at any distance above or below ground.
conditions: May bring an additional 250 gp weight per caster level, including possessions or living companions.

spells.name: Find Traps
effect: Makes magically or mechanically concealed traps visible to the cleric.
conditions: The caster must face the direction being inspected.

spells.name: Speak With Animals
effect: Allows questions and answers with normal, nonmindless animals. The animal and others of its kind with it refrain from attacking during the spell.
conditions: A neutral animal or one of similar moral disposition may offer a favor; the referee checks reactions using the cleric’s Charisma and behavior.
exceptions: Does not communicate with fantastic monsters or mindless life.
The PHB calls for a special reaction chart but does not identify it; the referee determines how to resolve the favor or service.

spells.name: Tongues
effect: Lets the cleric speak the racial or alignment language of any creature inside the area.
conditions: Reverse cancels tongues or confuses verbal communication within the area.

spells.name: Cure Disease
effect: Cures most diseases under the cleric procedure; complete recovery takes 1 turn to 1 week according to the disease and its progress.
conditions: Reverse cause disease requires a touch and failed save. After 1d6 turns it costs 1 hp/turn and 1 Strength/hour until both reach 10% of their original values.

spells.name: Neutralize Poison

fields.Saving throw: None; reverse allows a poison save

effect: Detoxifies existing venom, following the cleric spell.
conditions: Touching an unwilling opponent requires a melee hit. Reverse poison requires a successful touch and kills on a failed poison save.
exceptions: Does not prevent production of fresh poison.

spells.name: Cure Serious Wounds
effect: Heals 2d8+1 injury points, following the cleric version. Its reverse inflicts the same damage after a successful touch.
exceptions: Does not affect noncorporeal or nonliving creatures, or those harmed only by iron, silver or magical weapons.

spells.name: Cure Critical Wounds
effect: Heals 3d8+3 injury points, following the cleric version. Its reverse inflicts the same damage after a successful touch.
exceptions: Does not affect noncorporeal or nonliving creatures, or those harmed only by iron, silver or magical weapons.

spells.name: Detect Snares & Pits
effect: Detects outdoor traps such as deadfalls, missile trips and snares in the path.
exceptions: Underground it detects simple pits only, rather than every type of trap.

spells.name: Water Breathing
effect: Allows the recipient to breathe freely underwater.
conditions: Reverse air breathing allows a water-breathing creature to survive in air for the same duration.

spells.name: Commune with Nature
effect: Learns one fact about the surrounding natural territory per caster level, such as terrain, plants, minerals, water or inhabitants in a direction.
conditions: Works only outdoors.

spells.name: Protection From Fire

fields.Duration: Up to 1 turn/level; self-protection also has an absorption limit

effect: On the druid: grants immunity to normal and magical fire until it has absorbed 12 hp of potential damage per caster level, or the time expires.
On another creature: grants normal-fire immunity, +4 to saves against fire, and halves magical-fire damage.

spells.name: Detect Invisibility

fields.Material: A pinch of talc and powdered silver

effect: Reveals invisible objects and invisible, astral, ethereal, hidden or out-of-phase creatures within the detection path.

spells.name: Locate Object
effect: Points the caster toward a known or familiar object in range as the caster slowly turns.
exceptions: Cannot locate a living creature. Reverse obscure object hides an object from magical location, crystal balls and similar methods.

spells.name: Clairaudience

fields.Area: Hearing within a 6″ radius of the chosen location
fields.Material: A silver horn worth at least 100 gp, consumed

effect: Hears ordinary sounds at a chosen familiar or obvious location; distance is irrelevant.
conditions: Works only on the caster’s current plane.
exceptions: Metal sheeting or magical protections block it.

spells.name: Clairvoyance

fields.Area: Normal viewing range from the selected location; 1″ radius in darkness
fields.Material: Powdered pineal gland from a human or humanoid

effect: Views a familiar or obvious location without a distance limit.
conditions: Functions only on the caster’s current plane; available light still matters even if the caster has infravision or ultravision.
exceptions: Metal sheeting or magical protections block it. Duration is withheld because the OCR numeral is ambiguous.

spells.name: Tongues

fields.Material: A small clay ziggurat, which shatters

effect: Allows speech in the racial or alignment language of creatures inside the area, following the cleric spell.
conditions: Reverse cancels tongues or confuses verbal communication in the area.

spells.name: Dimension Door
effect: Instantly moves the caster to an exactly chosen position, specified by visualization or direction and distance.
conditions: Carries worn/carried matter up to 5,000 gp weight of nonliving material, or half as much living material. Recovery requires 7 segments.
exceptions: Arrival inside a solid body traps the caster, stunned and unable to cast, on the Astral plane until helped with dispel magic. Arrival without support causes a fall unless another effect intervenes.

spells.name: Teleport
effect: Instantly transports the caster and load to a destination; distance is irrelevant.
Payload limit is 2,500 gp weight, plus 1,500 gp weight per caster level above 10th.
conditions: Accuracy depends on familiarity; the arrival table on p.82 still requires visual verification before relying on its probabilities.
exceptions: No travel between planes. A high arrival can cause a fall; a low arrival into solid material causes instant death. The destination must have a substantial surface, rather than empty space.

spells.name: Deafness
effect: A failed save makes the target unable to hear any sound.
exceptions: Only the caster or dispel magic removes this effect.

spells.name: Detect Magic
effect: Detects magic using the cleric/magic-user detection rules, with the illusionist header’s casting time.
conditions: Caster may turn 60° per round. Stone at least 1 foot thick, solid metal 1 inch thick, or solid wood 3 feet thick blocks the detection.

spells.name: Detect Invisibility

fields.Material: Talc and powdered silver, following the referenced magic-user spell

effect: Reveals invisible objects and invisible, astral, ethereal, hidden or out-of-phase creatures in the detection path.
exceptions: Range is withheld because the illusionist header’s OCR is ambiguous; check p.94.

spells.name: Purify Food & Drink
effect: Makes spoiled, contaminated or poisoned food and drink fit for consumption.
exceptions: Reverse putrefies food and drink, including holy water; the normal form can spoil unholy water.

spells.name: Chant
effect: Friendly attack, damage and saving-throw rolls gain +1; enemy rolls of those kinds take −1.
conditions: The cleric must remain stationary and continue chanting.
exceptions: Damage, grappling, magical silence or another interruption breaks the chant.

spells.name: Detect Charm

fields.Area: One creature at a time; up to 10 checked

effect: Reveals whether a person or monster is under a charm.
exceptions: The reverse shields only one creature from charm detection.

spells.name: Know Alignment

fields.Area: One creature per round; up to 10

effect: Reads the exact alignment of a human, semihuman or nonhuman person.
conditions: Reverse hides one person’s alignment for 1 turn, two persons’ for 5 rounds, and so on.
exceptions: Some magical devices defeat the reading.

spells.name: Snake Charm

fields.Area: Snakes with total hp no greater than caster’s hp

effect: Makes the snakes cease activity and sway semi-upright.
conditions: Torpid snakes: 1d4+2 turns; calm but active snakes: 1d3 turns; angry or attacking snakes: 1d4+4 rounds.

spells.name: Spiritual Hammer

fields.Material: A normal war hammer, hurled during casting and consumed

effect: Creates a force hammer attacking as though the cleric personally wielded it: 1d6 damage against man-sized/smaller creatures, 1d4 against larger ones.
Counts as a magical weapon with one plus per 3 caster levels for eligibility to hit creatures; this gives no to-hit bonus.
conditions: Ends when concentration stops. If the cleric is behind an opponent, its attacks gain the rear-attack benefits described in the source.

spells.name: Animate Dead

fields.Area: 1 skeleton or zombie per caster level
fields.Material: A drop of blood, human flesh and bone powder or a bone shard

effect: Animates dead human bones or bodies as skeletons or zombies that obey the cleric’s orders.
conditions: Good clerics must weigh the act carefully and have a good reason; the source treats animation as morally problematic.

spells.name: Continual Light

fields.Saving throw: Special when cast on a creature

effect: Creates nearly daylight-bright illumination in air, on an object or on a creature.
Successful placement on visual organs can blind a creature.
conditions: A creature that saves places the effect about 1 foot behind it instead.
exceptions: Continual darkness or dispel magic can negate it. Reverse produces complete darkness.

spells.name: Create Food & Water

fields.Area: 1 cubic foot of food and/or water per level

effect: Creates nourishing food and/or water. One cubic foot of food sustains three human-sized creatures or one horse-sized creature for one day.

spells.name: Feign Death
effect: Creates a deathlike catalepsy: recipient can hear, smell and remain aware, but cannot see or feel; injury damage is halved.
Paralysis, poison and energy drain are suspended while the effect lasts.
conditions: Cleric version can affect a person of any level. Caster may end the effect, but bodily function takes 1 full round to resume.
exceptions: Poison is delayed, not removed; it can take effect afterward, allowing a save.

spells.name: Glyph Of Warding

fields.Casting time: 1 initial segment + 1 segment per square foot protected
fields.Saving throw: Depends on the glyph: negates or halves
fields.Material: Incense; beyond 50 square feet, powdered diamond worth at least 2,000 gp

effect: Sets an invisible ward against unauthorized passage, entry or opening. Touching the protected area without speaking its glyph name triggers it.
conditions: Examples include electrical/fire damage of 2 hp/level, paralysis, blindness or energy drain; the cleric must be high enough to use the chosen glyph.

spells.name: Locate Object
effect: As the cleric turns, identifies the direction of a known or familiar object in range.
exceptions: Does not affect living creatures. Reverse obscure object hides an object from magical location, crystal balls and similar methods.

spells.name: Speak With The Dead

fields.Area: One dead creature’s body or remains

effect: Asks questions of a dead creature, answered according to what it knew in life.
conditions: Caster must know a language the creature used. Maximum time dead, question count and questioning duration depend on cleric level.
exceptions: The printed p.48 entry gives the range as “1” without a visible unit; its level table overlaps at 7th level. The referee must resolve those uncertainties.

spells.name: Detect Lie

fields.Material: Gold dust; brass dust for the reverse

effect: Lets the recipient distinguish whether truth is being spoken.
exceptions: Reverse undetectable lie makes untruths seem reasonable or counters detect lie.
PHB p.40 lists this spell at level 4, while its p.48 description labels it level 3. A secondary transcription of Dragon #35 errata reports a correction to level 4; this record follows the spell list.

spells.name: Divination

fields.Material: A sacrificial creature, incense and holy symbol; potent attempts may require valuable gems, jewelry or magic items

effect: Reveals relative creature strength, treasure richness and risk of provoking powerful supernatural beings in a known area.
conditions: Base chance of correct information is 60% + 1% per caster level, adjusted by the referee; failure gives inaccurate information.

spells.name: Exorcise
effect: Attempts to end outside possession or control, including magic jar, demonic possession, curses or charm; can affect an enchanted object.
conditions: Once begun, interruption spoils the spell. Success is checked each turn against a random or referee-set base chance modified by relative levels.
A religious relic or artifact can improve success by 1%–50%, according to its power.
exceptions: The printed p.48 entry gives the range as “1” without a visible unit.

spells.name: Lower Water

fields.Area: Square with each side 1″ per caster level
fields.Material: Religious symbol and a pinch of dust

effect: Lowers water or similar liquid by 5% of its original level per caster level.
exceptions: Reverse returns the liquid to its normal highest level and raises it a further 1 foot per caster level.

spells.name: Protection From Evil, 10' Radius

fields.Material: Trace a 20-foot circle using holy water/incense, or blood/smoldering dung for the reverse

effect: Expands protection from evil to a group-sized globe: evil attackers take −2 to hit, protected recipients gain +2 saves against those attacks, and the specified enchanted/conjured/summoned creatures are kept from bodily contact.
exceptions: Reverse protects against good while still excluding enchanted evil creatures.

spells.name: Speak with Plants

fields.Material: A drop of water, dung and a flame

effect: Allows rudimentary conversation with living plants and commands such as parting thickets or tangling pursuers in vines.
exceptions: Does not give motion to vegetation that cannot normally move from place to place.

spells.name: Sticks to Snakes

fields.Area: 1 cubic ″; up to 1 stick per caster level
fields.Material: A small piece of bark and snake scales

effect: Turns sticks or similar wood into snakes that attack as commanded. Each snake has a 5% per caster level chance of being venomous.
conditions: The wood must be inside the area; enchanted wooden items are unaffected.
exceptions: Reverse turns snakes to sticks or counters this spell, limited to one snake per reverse-caster level.

spells.name: Atonement

fields.Material: Religious symbol, prayer device/book and burning incense

effect: Removes the burden of unwilling or unknowing deeds, or a magical alignment change.
conditions: Subject must be truly repentant or unable to exercise the will needed for repentance; the referee judges eligibility and prior uses.
exceptions: Cannot atone for deliberate, knowingly willful misdeeds.

spells.name: Commune

fields.Material: Religious symbol, holy/unholy water and incense

effect: Contacts the deity or its agents for correct yes/no answers, up to one question per caster level.
conditions: The referee may restrict frequency to once per adventure, week or month; frequent divine interruptions are unwelcome.

spells.name: Dispel Evil
effect: Returns evil summoned creatures, or enchanted creatures serving evil, to their own plane or place.
While it lasts, creatures subject to this spell attack the cleric at −7 to hit.
exceptions: Reverse dispel good works against corresponding good creatures or those sent to aid good.

spells.name: Flame Strike
effect: Calls down a column dealing 6d8 fire damage; a successful save reduces this to 3d8.

spells.name: Insect Plague

fields.Material: Sugar grains, kernels of grain and a smear of fat

effect: Swarm restricts vision to 3″ and inflicts 1 hp per round regardless of armor.
Creatures of 2 HD or less automatically flee; those below 5 HD check morale and flee on failure, moving randomly until at least 24″ from the cloud.
conditions: Heavy smoke and fire drive insects out of their area. Fireball, lightning or cold clears only its area for 1 turn.
exceptions: Dispel magic at the summoning center ends it; invisibility offers no protection.

spells.name: Plane Shift

fields.Area: Touched creature, or up to 7 linked persons
fields.Material: A small forked metal rod; its size and metal determine the destination plane

effect: Moves the caster or another creature to another plane. Up to seven persons may travel together by linking hands in a circle.
conditions: Destination-plane specifics and the required fork are determined by the referee. Return needs another suitable means.
An unwilling target must be successfully touched and fails to travel if it saves.

spells.name: Quest
effect: Compels a service followed by return to the cleric with proof of completion.
conditions: Disregard, delay or distortion of the quest imposes a cumulative −1 on saving throws per day; it remains until proper discharge or cancellation.
The referee determines circumstances that suspend or cancel a quest.

spells.name: True Seeing

fields.Material: Eye ointment of rare mushroom powder, saffron and fat; aged 1–6 months

effect: Reveals secret doors, displacement, invisibility, astral/ethereal creatures, illusions and changed forms as they really are.
Auras show good, evil or neither.
exceptions: Reverse false seeing distorts perceived qualities; its ointment uses oil, poppy dust and pink orchid essence, also aged 1–6 months.

spells.name: Aerial Servant
effect: Summons an invisible aerial servant to retrieve a described object or creature it can physically carry. It is a fetcher rather than an ordinary combat ally.
conditions: Caster needs protection from evil, a suitable magic circle/triangle/pentagram, or an appropriate religious symbol/artifact/relic to control it; without protection it slays the summoner.
Retrieval normally gains 4 free surprise rounds; a target able to detect invisibility uses the source’s surprise roll. A successful hit grabs the target, followed by a strength comparison.
exceptions: Ends on completion, release, dispelling, expiry or the cleric’s death. Interference with its mission can have dangerous consequences.

spells.name: Animate Object

fields.Area: 1 cubic foot of solid material per level

effect: Animates one or more objects to attack the initially designated target. Any material can be animated.
conditions: Movement, attack frequency, damage, armor class and durability depend on shape, material and mass; the referee decides these values.
Flexible objects can obstruct, trip, bind or smother; harder objects can strike or crush.

spells.name: Blade Barrier

fields.Area: From a 5-foot square up to a 2″ square

effect: An immobile barrier of circling blades deals 8d8 damage to a creature attempting to pass through.
conditions: Maximum square is described as 20 × 20 feet underground or 60 × 60 feet outdoors.

spells.name: Conjure Animals

fields.Area: Mammals totaling no more HD than caster level

effect: Calls one or more mammals that unfailingly attack the cleric’s opponents.
conditions: For HD budgeting, each additional +1 hp in a creature’s HD expression counts as ¼ HD.

spells.name: Find The Path

fields.Material: Divination counters such as bones, ivory, sticks or carved runes

effect: Reveals the shortest direct route into, out of or toward a sought location, including the actions needed to follow it.
Frees the cleric and companions from maze in 1 round and continues to defeat it while active.
exceptions: Reverse lose the path leaves the touched creature lost for the duration, though another can lead it.

spells.name: Part Water

fields.Duration: 1 turn/level or until caster ends it
fields.Area: Trough: 3 feet deep × 1 foot wide × 2″ long per caster level

effect: Parts water or similar liquid to form a trough whose depth, width and length increase with caster level.
conditions: At level 12, the example is 36 feet deep, 12 feet wide and 24″ long.

spells.name: Speak With Monsters
effect: Allows communication with any creature that has a form of communication; creatures of the same chosen type in range also understand.
conditions: Understanding is not obedience or friendliness: the referee determines reactions, and conversation depends on willingness and ability.

spells.name: Stone Tell

fields.Material: A drop of mercury and clay

effect: Makes stone describe who or what touched it and what lies covered, hidden or behind it.

spells.name: Astral Spell

fields.Area: Caster and up to 5 linked fellow travelers

effect: Projects an astral body while the physical body and ordinary possessions remain behind. Certain multiplanar magic items can accompany it.
Permits astral travel and access to the first levels of the Outer Planes; a second body cannot be formed on the Prime Material plane.
conditions: Travelers must link with the cleric in a circle; companions depend on the cleric and may be stranded.
The silver cord connects astral and material bodies; severing it kills both. The physical body must remain safe.
exceptions: Astral actions ordinarily affect only astral creatures. Dispel magic or destruction of the physical body can terminate the spell.

spells.name: Control Weather

fields.Casting time: 1 turn; changes appear after another 1d4 turns
fields.Material: Religious symbol, incense and prayer beads or similar objects

effect: Changes cloud/precipitation, temperature and wind within the transitions permitted by the source table.
conditions: Changes cannot be contradictory or jump arbitrarily between extremes. Multiple castings must be successive.
Works only where appropriate climatic conditions exist.
exceptions: The full permitted-transition table is not reproduced; consult printed p.52 before selecting changes.

spells.name: Earthquake

fields.Area: Circle with diameter ½″ per caster level
fields.Material: A pinch of dirt, a rock fragment and clay

effect: Creates a violent local tremor: cave/tunnel roofs collapse, cliffs can slide, marshes drain and terrain cracks.
On cracked ground, fatal falls occur on 1-in-4 for small, 1-in-6 for medium and 1-in-8 for large creatures.
conditions: One tree in three is uprooted. Structures take 5d12 structural damage, with fully damaged structures collapsing.

Terrain effects: cave or cavern roofs collapse; cliffs crumble in landslides; ground cracks open, killing creatures that fall in (size S: 1 in 4; M: 1 in 6; L: 1 in 8); marsh drains and becomes muddy, rough ground; tunnels cave in.

spells.name: Gate
effect: Opens a planar connection and calls the attention of a specifically named powerful being, such as a deity, demon or devil. Something is certain to come through.
conditions: The arriving being’s actions depend on its nature, the cleric, companions and opposition; the referee resolves the outcome.
exceptions: Calling a being does not guarantee obedience or aid.

spells.name: Holy (Unholy) Word
effect: Forces opposed evil/good extraplanar creatures back to their own planes.
Other creatures of differing alignment can be killed, paralyzed, stunned or deafened according to HD/level.
exceptions: Creatures of differing alignment: less than 4 HD or levels are killed; 4 to 7+ are paralyzed for 1–4 turns; 8 to 11+ are stunned for 2–8 rounds, move at −50%, and attack at −4; 12 or more are deafened for 1–4 rounds, move at −25%, attack at −2, and have a 50% spell failure chance. The plus signs are printed in the table.

spells.name: Regenerate
effect: Regrows lost members, bones or organs. Reattachment takes 1 round if the severed part is present and touching the body; otherwise growth takes 2–8 turns.
exceptions: Reverse wither makes the touched organ/member stop working after 1 round and turn to dust in 2–8 turns; harmful use requires a touch.

spells.name: Restoration
effect: Restores one previously drained life-energy level, placing XP exactly at the restored level’s threshold and returning its associated level functions.
Also restores intelligence lost to feeblemind.
conditions: Must be cast within 1 day per cleric level after the drain.
exceptions: Reverse energy drain removes one life-energy level and requires a touch.

spells.name: Resurrection

fields.Saving throw: None in header; see Raise Dead eligibility

effect: Restores life and full strength to an eligible person dead up to 10 years per cleric level, even from bones.
conditions: Eligible persons follow Raise Dead’s limitations (p.50).
Caster cannot fight or cast afterward until resting 1 day for each level of the person restored or destroyed.
exceptions: Reverse destruction kills the touched victim and turns it to dust.

spells.name: Wind Walk

fields.Duration: Up to 6 turns/level, ended at will

effect: Changes travelers into misty, transparent cloudlike forms moved by a magical wind at 6″–60″ per turn.
conditions: Travelers remain visible; white clothing gives an 80% chance of being mistaken for cloud, fog or vapor.
exceptions: The printed p.54 text says one or two other persons, but also describes another person for every eight cleric levels up to 24; exact passenger capacity remains unclear.

spells.name: Symbol

fields.Area: Symbol inscribed in air or on a surface

effect: Choose one symbol when casting: hopelessness causes retreat or surrender for 3–12 turns; pain imposes −4 to hit and −2 Dexterity for 2–20 turns; persuasion makes viewers friendly and of the cleric’s alignment for 1–20 turns.

spells.name: Animal Friendship

fields.Duration: Permanent, subject to training and care
fields.Area: One animal; total attracted/trained HD limited to twice caster level
fields.Material: Mistletoe and food attractive to the animal

effect: Befriends a neutral animal of animal-to-semi-intelligent rating. A failed initial save keeps it quiet during casting; afterward it follows the druid.
conditions: Can learn 3 simple tricks per Intelligence point, taking 1 week of training per trick; all training must occur within 3 months of acquisition.
Leaving it alone for more than 3 days lets it return to its natural state.

spells.name: Detect Magic
effect: Detects magical radiation in the direction faced, following the cleric detection rules.
conditions: Caster can turn 60° per round. Detection is blocked by at least 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of solid metal, or 3 feet of solid wood.

spells.name: Speak With Animals
effect: Allows conversation with normal, nonmindless animals of the chosen kind, following the cleric version.
conditions: Animals of that kind refrain from attacking during the spell. Favor or service depends on the referee’s reaction check.
exceptions: Does not allow conversation with fantastic monsters or mindless life.
The PHB calls for a special reaction chart but does not identify it; the referee determines how to resolve the favor or service.

spells.name: Charm Person or Mammal

fields.Duration: Until broken or a renewal save succeeds
fields.Renewal saves: Int ≤3: every 3 months; 4–6: 2 months; 7–9: 1 month; 10–12: 3 weeks; 13–14: 2 weeks; 15–16: 1 week; 17: 3 days; 18: 2 days; 19+: 1 day.

effect: Subject regards the druid as a trusted friend and ally, interpreting requests favorably rather than obeying as an automaton.
conditions: Applies to mammals and approximately man-sized or smaller human/humanoid persons described in the source.
Does not grant language knowledge or compel obvious suicide.
exceptions: An overt attempt by the druid to harm the subject, or successful dispel magic, breaks the spell.

spells.name: Create Water
effect: Creates pure drinking water at the chosen point in range.
exceptions: This druid version uses cubic feet per level; the cleric version has a different quantity and casting time.

spells.name: Feign Death
effect: Creates a cataleptic state indistinguishable from death. Subject can hear, smell and remain aware but cannot see or feel; injury damage is halved.
conditions: Subject’s levels/HD cannot exceed the caster’s. Ending the effect requires 1 full round for bodily functions to resume.
exceptions: Paralysis, poison and energy drain are suspended. Poison is not neutralized and may act afterward, allowing a save.

spells.name: Fire Trap

fields.Area: One closable object; explosion has 5-foot radius
fields.Material: Mistletoe, holly berries and charcoal to mark the closure

effect: A forbidden opening/touch triggers an explosion dealing 1d4 + caster level damage, halved on a save. The caster can use the object safely; the object is unharmed.
conditions: Only half the normal trap-detection chance applies; a failed removal attempt triggers it.
exceptions: Knock does not neutralize the trap. With hold portal, only the first spell works; simultaneous casting negates both.
Fire trap cast after wizard lock is negated; simultaneous castings negate both. Wizard lock cast after fire trap has a 50% chance to negate both.

spells.name: Locate Plants

fields.Area: Circle 1″ in diameter per caster level

effect: Locates one desired type of plant within the area centered on and moving with the druid.
conditions: Concentrate on one plant type at a time.

spells.name: Obscurement

fields.Area: Cube with side 1″/level; underground height capped at 1″

effect: Creates stationary mist reducing all visibility, including infravision, to 2d4 feet.
conditions: A strong wind shortens its duration by 75%.

spells.name: Produce Flame

fields.Area: Palm flame; thrown impact ignites a 3-foot-diameter area

effect: Creates a torch-bright flame in the palm that does not hurt the druid but ignites flammable material.
Can be thrown as a missile; it flashes on impact and goes out.
conditions: The caster can extinguish the magical flame at will, but cannot thereby extinguish ordinary fires it started.

spells.name: Trip

fields.Saving throw: Negates; +4 if aware of the obstacle
fields.Area: One object up to 10 feet long
fields.Material: Mistletoe and a vine, stick, pole, rope or similar object

effect: Enchants an object lying on the ground to rise and trip creatures stepping over it, including the caster.
Running victims falling on a hard surface take 1d6 damage and are stunned 1d4+1 rounds; on softer ground they are stunned 1d4+1 segments.
conditions: Only creatures actually crossing the object can be tripped. It is 80% undetectable without magical means.
exceptions: Very large creatures such as elephants are unaffected.

spells.name: Warp Wood

fields.Area: About a 15-inch-long, 1-inch-diameter wooden shaft per caster level

effect: Warps wooden objects, ruining their shape and strength. Can spring doors, make hulls leak or distort weapon shafts.
conditions: The source’s level-5 example can affect the shaft of a typical magical spear.

spells.name: Call Lightning

fields.Saving throw: Half the number of damage dice
fields.Area: 72″-diameter region; strike affects creatures within 1″ of its path/impact

effect: Calls a bolt dealing (caster level + 2)d8 damage, at most once per 10 rounds, for up to caster level turns.
conditions: Requires suitable stormy or hot/cloudy weather; normally works only outdoors.
A successful save halves the number of damage dice rolled, as expressly stated in the description.

spells.name: Hold Animal

fields.Area: 1–4 normal or giant mammals, birds or reptiles

effect: Holds the chosen animals rigid. Each mammal may weigh up to 400 pounds per caster level; each nonmammal up to 100 pounds per level.
conditions: One target saves at −4; two each at −2; three each at −1; four save normally.
exceptions: Does not affect fantastic monsters such as centaurs, gorgons, harpies or naga.

spells.name: Plant Growth

fields.Area: Square with each side up to 2″ per caster level, or an equal-area rectangle

effect: Turns existing brush and trees into a dense entangling thicket that must be hacked or forced through.
conditions: Requires suitable vegetation already present. Labor, fire or dispel magic can clear it.
exceptions: The printed p.58 description gives movement as 1″ per unspecified interval, or 2″ per unspecified interval for larger-than-man-sized creatures; the time unit is not printed.

spells.name: Pyrotechnics
effect: Choose fireworks that temporarily blind creatures in unobstructed view in/below the display or within 12″, or choking smoke blocking vision beyond 2 feet.
conditions: Either form immediately extinguishes the source fire. Smoke fills a roughly globular volume or conforms to confinement.

spells.name: Snare

fields.Area: Loop 2 feet in diameter + ⅙ foot/level
fields.Material: Mistletoe, snake skin, strong-animal sinew and a supple vine/thong/rope

effect: Creates a 90% concealed snare. A suitable springing tree lifts the victim for 1d6 damage, or can strangle a head/neck caught in the loop; without a tree it binds without damage.
conditions: Initially needs Strength 23 to break. Required Strength drops hourly: 22 after 2 hours, 21 after 3, down to 18 after 6. At 12 hours the magic fades and opens the loop.

spells.name: Stone Shape

fields.Material: Mistletoe and soft clay roughly modeled into the desired form

effect: Reshapes existing stone into a useful form such as a door, weapon or container. Touch the shaped clay to the stone while casting.
conditions: Fine detail is limited.

spells.name: Summon Insects

fields.Area: One selected victim at a time
fields.Material: Mistletoe, a flower petal and mud/wet clay

effect: Attracts flying insects 70% of the time; otherwise crawling insects. Victim takes 2 hp/round and can only try to fend them off.
conditions: Switching targets takes at least 1 round. Crawling insects travel up to 12 feet/round on smooth ground.
Underground there is a 30% possibility of 1–4 giant ants unless such ants are already nearby.

spells.name: Tree
effect: Assumes a small living tree/shrub or large dead trunk form, indistinguishable by ordinary inspection. The druid remains fully aware of surroundings.
conditions: May end the transformation instantly and resume normal activity; equipment transforms with the caster.

spells.name: Animal Summoning I

fields.Duration: Until aid is completed or creatures are sent away
fields.Area: Up to 8 animals, each no more than 4 HD

effect: Calls a named kind of nearby animal to aid the druid until the fight/mission ends, safety is reached or it is dismissed.
conditions: Can try three different kinds if earlier calls fail; creatures must actually be in range.
exceptions: Giant animals qualify; fantastic monsters do not.

spells.name: Call Woodland Beings

fields.Casting time: Uninterrupted until answered, up to 2 turns
fields.Saving throw: −4 to resist the call; special second save
fields.Material: Mistletoe, a pinecone and 8 holly berries

effect: May call 2–8 brownies, 1–4 centaurs, 1–4 dryads, 1–8 pixies, 1–4 satyrs, 1–6 sprites, 1 treant or 1 unicorn, if present in range.
conditions: Works outdoors. Arrivals are friendly, but combat aid requires a loyalty reaction check.
Evil in the caller’s party gives the beings a second save at +4 when they approach within 1″ of the druid or evil companion; success makes them seek escape.

spells.name: Control Temperature, 10' Radius
effect: Raises or lowers the surrounding temperature by up to 9°F per caster level.

spells.name: Dispel Magic
effect: Uses the cleric dispel procedure: 50% base chance, +5% per level above the original caster, −2% per level below; automatic against the caster’s own spells.
conditions: Can destroy potions, treating them as 12th level.
exceptions: Does not remove the inherent enchantment of specially magical items.

spells.name: Hallucinatory Forest
effect: Creates a convincing illusory forest that affects travel and marching arrangements as though real. Shape may be square or rectangular.
conditions: Other druids, centaurs, dryads, green dragons, nymphs, satyrs and treants recognize the illusion.
exceptions: Reverse or dispel magic removes it.

spells.name: Hold Plant

fields.Area: 1–4 plants, or 4–16 square yards of low growth

effect: Stops vegetation from walking, entwining, grasping, closing, growing, sounding or moving except through wind. Includes fungi, parasites and magically animated vegetation.
conditions: One plant corresponds to 4 square yards of small growth for target-count/save purposes.

spells.name: Plant Door

fields.Area: Passage up to 4 feet wide, 8 feet high and 12 feet/level long

effect: Opens a way through vegetation, even magical growth; also lets the caster hide inside a solid tree.
conditions: Only the casting druid, higher-level druids and dryads may use the passage.
exceptions: If a sheltering tree is felled or burned, the druid must leave before it falls or is consumed, or die with it.

spells.name: Produce Fire
effect: Creates ordinary fire dealing 1d4 damage to creatures in its area and igniting combustibles, which can continue burning afterward.
exceptions: Reverse quench fire extinguishes ordinary fires in the area.

spells.name: Protection from Lightning
effect: Applies protection from fire’s rules to electrical/lightning attacks: the druid’s self-protection absorbs up to 12 hp/level; another recipient gains +4 to saves and halves magical-attack damage.
conditions: Self-protection ends when its absorption limit or the 1-turn/level duration is reached.

spells.name: Repel Insects

fields.Material: Mistletoe and crushed marigolds, a crushed leek, 7 crushed stinging-nettle leaves, or camphor-tree resin

effect: Keeps ordinary insects outside the barrier. Giant insects of 2+ HD may enter on a save but take 1d6 damage crossing.
exceptions: Does not affect spiders, myriapods or other non-insects.

spells.name: Speak With Plants

fields.Material: Mistletoe and the usual druidic adjuncts

effect: Allows rudimentary conversation and commands to living plants, using the cleric spell’s effects.
exceptions: Does not grant walking movement to stationary plants.

spells.name: Animal Growth

fields.Area: Up to 8 animals within a 2″ square

effect: Doubles affected animals’ size, HD and combat damage, with corresponding improvement in attack potential.
exceptions: Reverse halves size, HD, damage and related values.

spells.name: Animal Summoning II

fields.Area: Up to 6 animals of 8 HD each, or 12 of 4 HD each

effect: Calls nearby animals to assist until the fight/mission ends, safety is reached or they are dismissed, using animal summoning I’s rules.
conditions: Can try three different kinds; fantastic monsters are excluded.

spells.name: Anti-Plant Shell
effect: Creates a hemispherical barrier keeping out creatures and missiles made of living vegetable matter, including attacking plants and treants.

spells.name: Control Winds

fields.Area: Hemisphere of 4″ radius/level; calm eye of 4″ radius

effect: Changes wind strength by up to 3 mph per caster level, building and fading at 3 mph per round.
Above 30/45/60 mph, progressively larger flying creatures are grounded; above 75 mph, hurricane devastation and ship sinking occur.
conditions: A higher-level druid can counter a lower-level druid’s casting. Confinement shrinks the calm eye and may expose the caster to the wind.

spells.name: Insect Plague

fields.Material: Mistletoe, or holly/oak substitutes under normal druid component rules

effect: Uses the cleric plague effects: vision limited to 3″, 1 hp damage/round regardless of armor, automatic flight for 2 HD or less and morale checks below 5 HD.
conditions: Fire/smoke can exclude insects locally; burst attacks clear their area for 1 turn.
exceptions: Dispel magic at the center ends it; invisibility gives no protection.

spells.name: Pass Plant

fields.Duration: 1-segment transit; may remain in destination tree up to 1 round/level
fields.Area: Two living trees of the same type
fields.Tree ranges: Oak 60″; ash 54″; yew 48″; elm 42″; linden 36″; other deciduous 30″; coniferous 24″; other 18″.

effect: Enters one tree and emerges from another of the same kind in roughly the chosen direction. Both must be at least as broad as the druid.
conditions: If the only eligible tree lies elsewhere, travel may go there instead. Without a matching tree in range, the druid remains in the entry tree and must emerge within the allowed time.
exceptions: Burning or chopping a sheltering tree has plant door’s dangers.

spells.name: Sticks To Snakes
effect: Transforms sticks into commanded attacking snakes; each has a 5% per caster level chance of being venomous, following the cleric version.
exceptions: Enchanted wood is unaffected. Reverse turns snakes to sticks, limited to one snake per reverse-caster level.

spells.name: Transmute Rock To Mud
effect: Changes natural rock into equal-volume mud. Creatures unable to fly, levitate or otherwise escape can sink and suffocate; naturally light creatures may cross it.
conditions: Mud depth cannot exceed half its length and/or breadth. Drying takes 1–6 days per cubic ″ depending on sun, wind and drainage.
exceptions: Reverse mud to rock hardens ordinary mud into soft stone. Restoration of substance does not guarantee restoration of shape.

spells.name: Wall Of Fire

fields.Duration: While concentrating, or 1 round/level without concentration
fields.Area: Sheet up to 2″ square/level, or a 2″-high ring with radius up to ½″/level

effect: Crossing deals 4–16 damage +1/level; creatures within 1″ take 2–8, within 2″ take 1–4. Undead take double. Only the side away from the caster deals damage.
conditions: Sheet is stationary; ring moves with the druid.

spells.name: Animal Summoning III

fields.Area: Up to 4 animals of 16 HD, 8 of 8 HD, or 16 of 4 HD

effect: Uses animal summoning I’s nearby-animal aid and dismissal rules.
conditions: Can try three different kinds; fantastic monsters are excluded.

spells.name: Anti-Animal Shell
effect: Excludes normal, nonmagical animal matter, including giants.
exceptions: Undead and magical beings such as aerial servants, demons and devils can pass through.

spells.name: Conjure Fire Elemental
effect: Summons a 16-HD fire elemental 85% of the time; 9% brings 2–4 salamanders, 4% an efreeti, and 2% a 21–24-HD fire elemental.
conditions: Druid needs neither a protective circle nor continuous concentration, and the summoned force does not turn on the druid.
exceptions: Ends by expiry, attack, dispelling or dismiss fire elemental. Only a druid can dismiss the salamanders, efreeti or exceptionally powerful elementals.

spells.name: Feeblemind

fields.Save modifiers: Cleric +1; druid −1; human magic-user −4; illusionist −5; combination or nonhuman caster −2.

effect: Devastates a spell-user’s intellect until heal, restoration or wish removes the effect.
conditions: Applies only to persons or creatures that use magic spells.

spells.name: Fire Seeds

fields.Range: Acorns: 4″; berries: tossed 6 feet, command range 4″
fields.Saving throw: Half burst damage; direct acorn hits take full
fields.Area: Up to 4 acorns or 8 holly berries
fields.Material: Only acorns or holly berries; no mistletoe needed

effect: Acorns are missiles that burst for 2d8 damage and ignite combustibles within a 1″-diameter area.
Berries are placed incendiaries detonated by a command word, dealing 1d8 damage in a ½″-diameter burst and igniting combustibles.
conditions: An acorn must hit its target. A direct hit gets full damage; surrounding creatures may save for half.

spells.name: Transport Via Plants

fields.Duration: 1 round transit; special if destination is dead
fields.Area: Entry and destination plants of the same species

effect: Passes any distance between living plants large enough for entry; destination need not be familiar. Direction/distance can guide arrival near an uncertain destination.
conditions: Misdirection chance is 20% −1% per caster level, landing at an allied species 1–100 miles from the intended plant.
exceptions: A dead specified destination makes the spell fail; emerge from the entry plant within 24 hours. Harm to an occupied plant can harm the druid.

spells.name: Turn Wood

fields.Material: Greater mistletoe assumed by the source

effect: Sweeps wooden objects away at 4″/round, dragging their carriers. Fixed wood under 3 inches diameter splinters and joins the moving material; loose larger objects also move.
conditions: Fixed wood over 3 inches diameter is unaffected. The path stays fixed after casting; the druid may act or leave without ending it.

spells.name: Wall Of Thorns
effect: Creates dense thorny brush. Impacting or crossing each 1″ thickness deals 8 + armor class damage, with negative AC reducing the amount. Creatures caught as it appears count as impacting and must break through to move.
conditions: Cutting through 1″ thickness takes at least 4 turns. Ordinary fire fails; magical fire burns it away in 2 turns while acting as wall of fire.
exceptions: The printed p.62 volume statements and dimensional examples conflict, so total volume remains unresolved.

spells.name: Weather Summoning

fields.Area: About 1 to 100+ square miles, depending on weather

effect: Summons weather appropriate to local season and climate; weather afterward is not under the druid’s control.
conditions: A trend becomes visible within 4 turns; arrival takes 1d12+5 turns. Several druids can cooperate for greater extremes.
exceptions: Inferior components sharply limit the extremes possible.

spells.name: Animate Rock
effect: Animates a separate stone object to carry out one brief, simply worded action such as attack, break or block.
conditions: Only one instruction set, about 12 words, may be given. The stone has no independent intelligence.
exceptions: Must be a separate object, not a portion of a larger boulder; other movement/attack characteristics follow animate object.

spells.name: Chariot Of Sustarre

fields.Area: Druid plus up to 8 man-sized passengers
fields.Material: Mistletoe, wood, 2 holly berries and at least a torch-sized fire

effect: Calls a flaming chariot and two horses: speed 24″ on ground, 48″ flying; controlled by spoken commands.
Caster must first touch passengers. Others within 5 feet take wall of fire damage.
conditions: Chariot and each horse are AC 2 with 30 hp; only magical weapons or water harm them, at 1 hp per quart.
exceptions: Fire does not harm vehicle or steeds. Riders can still be harmed by outside magical fire.

spells.name: Confusion

fields.Saving throw: −2, checked each round except while wandering
fields.Behavior roll: 01–10: wander away for 1 turn; 11–60: stand confused for 1 round; 61–80: attack nearest creature for 1 round; 81–00: attack druid/party for 1 round.

effect: Affects 2–8 creatures plus any positive difference between caster level and the strongest opponent’s level/HD in range. Nearest eligible creatures are affected first.
conditions: Save and behavior are checked at the start of each round. A wandering subject moves as far away as possible for 1 turn before further checks.

spells.name: Conjure Earth Elemental
effect: Summons a 16-HD earth elemental to obey spoken commands without ongoing concentration or hostility toward the druid.
exceptions: Remains until destroyed, dispelled, dismissed or the spell expires.

spells.name: Control Weather

fields.Material: Greater mistletoe permits the stronger changes

effect: Uses the cleric weather-control rules, but greater mistletoe permits changes two places from prevailing conditions.
exceptions: The permitted-weather transition table is referenced rather than extracted; consult p.52 for valid changes.

spells.name: Creeping Doom
effect: Calls 500–1,000 venomous crawling creatures moving at 1″/round. Each can inflict 1 hp on a target vulnerable to normal attacks, then dies; the mass can therefore deal up to 1,000 damage.
conditions: Beyond 8″ from the druid it loses 50 creatures for each further 1″ traveled.
exceptions: The creatures can be thwarted or destroyed by appropriate means; they are not an irresistible damage effect.

spells.name: Finger of Death
effect: Points a finger and stops the target’s heart if it fails the saving throw; success negates the spell.

spells.name: Fire Storm
effect: Sheets of fire deal 2–16 + caster level damage to creatures inside or within 1″ of the edge. Height is 1″ or 2″, with remaining volume in length/width.
exceptions: Reverse fire quench extinguishes twice the normal area of ordinary fire, or has 5% per level chance to extinguish magical fire no larger than the normal fire-storm area.

spells.name: Reincarnate
effect: Returns a person dead no more than 1 week in a randomly determined new body, appearing 1–6 turns after the corpse is touched.
conditions: Any player-character type can be reincarnated. Memories mostly remain, but class, abilities and speech may change.
exceptions: The full outcome table and magic-user-table fallback are not extracted; consult PHB p.64 and pp.85–86.

spells.name: Transmute Metal to Wood

fields.Area: One metal object, up to 80 gp weight/level

effect: Changes metal into wood. Magical metal objects have only a 10% chance of being affected.
exceptions: Dispel magic cannot reverse the transformation.

spells.name: Audible Glamer
effect: Creates a chosen illusory sound at a position in range, seeming to move nearer, farther or remain stationary.
conditions: A declared attempt to disbelieve permits a save; success makes the sound vanish or become faint.
exceptions: Volume scaling refers to the magic-user description’s level-3 baseline; its application to lower-level illusionists is not explicit and is left for source/referee review.

spells.name: Dancing Lights
effect: Creates 1–4 torch/lanternlike lights, glowing spheres, or one dim humanoid light shape.
Lights move as directed without sustained concentration.
conditions: They disappear if they exceed range or duration.

spells.name: Darkness
effect: Creates total darkness that defeats normal vision, infravision and ultravision.
conditions: Light or continual light can counter it; ordinary illumination cannot.
exceptions: Radius is withheld: the illusionist header’s OCR conflicts with the referenced 15-foot-radius magic-user spell.

spells.name: Light

fields.Saving throw: Special if cast on a creature

effect: Creates torch-bright illumination; follows the cleric version with this card’s header differences.
conditions: Requires sight or an unobstructed path. A creature’s successful save moves the effect immediately behind it.

spells.name: Phantasmal Force
effect: Creates a visual illusion of a creature, object or force; believing viewers can suffer illusory injury. The illusion can move within range.
conditions: Caster must concentrate; moving or taking a damaging hit ends it. A struck illusion must react appropriately or end.
Disbelievers may save; success reveals the illusion and gives informed allies +4 to their disbelief saves.
exceptions: No sound is created. Creatures that do not observe it are unaffected.

spells.name: Fog Cloud

fields.Visibility: Obscures sight beyond 2 feet, following wall of fog.

effect: Creates greenish mist resembling cloudkill, moving away from the caster at 1″/round.
exceptions: It only obscures vision, as wall of fog; it does not poison or kill.

spells.name: Hypnotic Pattern

fields.Material: Glowing incense or a crystal rod containing phosphorescent material

effect: A shifting colored pattern fascinates creatures looking at it, holding them gazing while the caster maintains it.
conditions: Each affected creature must be in the area and may save. No verbal component is required.

spells.name: Improved Phantasmal Force

fields.Material: Fleece from the referenced phantasmal force

effect: Uses phantasmal force’s visual/belief effects, adding minor sounds but no understandable speech.
conditions: Caster may move at half speed while maintaining it but cannot cast another spell.
Disbelief and communication of successful disbelief use the phantasmal force rules.

spells.name: Invisibility
effect: Hides the recipient and gear from normal sight and infravision.
conditions: Does not silence noise. Any attack ends the invisibility, allowing the initial attack from hiding.
Allies cannot see the recipient unless they can perceive invisibility.
exceptions: Highly intelligent creatures with 10+ HD/levels or equivalent may detect invisible subjects.

spells.name: Magic Mouth
effect: An object speaks a message of up to 25 words over 1 turn when a specified visible event occurs; message must use a language the caster knows.
conditions: Trigger-detection range is ½″ per caster level. Criteria may be detailed, but cannot detect invisibility, alignment, level/HD or class except through visible clothing.
exceptions: Cannot cast a spell or be placed on an intelligent animal/vegetable creature.

spells.name: Mirror Image
effect: Creates 1d4+1 exact duplicates that mimic the caster and shift positions between rounds, obscuring which is real.
conditions: A weapon hit destroys the struck image; others remain until struck or duration ends. Finding the real caster once does not identify them next round.

spells.name: Misdirection
effect: Makes a detection spell report the wrong area/creature, or the opposite truth for detect evil or detect lie.
conditions: The caster of the detection spell saves; a failed save permits the false reading.

spells.name: Ventriloquism
effect: Projects a voice or imitable sound as though it comes from another creature, object or location.
conditions: Requires a language or sound the caster can normally produce. A listener has a 10% chance per Intelligence point above 12 to recognize the trick.

spells.name: Continual Darkness

fields.Material: Bat fur and a drop of pitch or piece of coal

effect: Creates impenetrable darkness, defeating infravision and ultravision.
conditions: Light and continual light can counter it; ordinary illumination cannot.

spells.name: Continual Light

fields.Saving throw: Special when cast on a creature

effect: Creates nearly daylight-bright illumination; successful placement on visual organs can blind a creature.
conditions: A target creature that saves places the light about 1 foot behind itself instead.
exceptions: Continual darkness or dispel magic can negate it.

spells.name: Dispel Illusion
effect: Dispels a non-illusionist’s phantasmal force, with or without audible glamer.
Against another illusionist’s illusion/phantasm, chance is 50%, +5% per level above that caster or −2% per level below.

spells.name: Fear
effect: Failed-save creatures flee at maximum speed beginning next round. They may immediately drop held objects: 60% at 1st level/HD, minus 5% per additional level/HD.
conditions: Held-item drop chance reaches 0% at 13 levels/HD, as in the source example.
