exceptions: Cone-base width is withheld because its OCR fraction is ambiguous.

spells.name: Hallucinatory Terrain

fields.Duration: Until dispelled or contacted by an intelligent creature
fields.Material: A stone, twig and green leaf/grass

effect: Disguises actual terrain as another kind, making easy ground appear hazardous or concealing genuine hazards.
conditions: An intelligent creature’s contact or dispel magic ends it.

spells.name: Illusionary Script
effect: Only designated readers can understand the writing; it appears foreign or magical to others, though another illusionist recognizes the technique.
conditions: An unauthorized reader is confused for 5–20 turns minus 1 turn per reader level.

spells.name: Invisibility, 10' Radius
effect: Applies invisibility to the group; affected creatures cannot see one another.
conditions: A creature attacking reveals only itself, unless the central spell recipient breaks the spell. Invisibility’s other perception/noise limits still apply.

spells.name: Non-Detection
effect: Hides the illusionist from divinations such as clairaudience, clairvoyance, detection spells and ESP, as well as locating items such as crystal balls.

spells.name: Paralyzation

fields.Area: 2″ × 2″; total target HD up to twice caster level

effect: Creates illusory muscular slowdown that paralyzes failed-save creatures.
conditions: Caster can end it; dispel illusion or dispel magic also removes it.

spells.name: Rope Trick

fields.Material: Powdered corn extract and a twisted parchment loop

effect: Raises a rope into an extradimensional refuge for the caster and up to five others, climbing one at a time.
conditions: The rope may be pulled inside only if fewer than six people entered.
exceptions: Leave before expiry or fall from the original climbing height when the space disappears.

spells.name: Spectral Force
effect: Extends improved phantasmal force with sound, smell and temperature illusions.
conditions: Otherwise follows improved phantasmal force’s concentration and disbelief rules.
exceptions: This entry does not specify its material item; no specific component is invented here.

spells.name: Suggestion

fields.Material: Snake’s tongue plus honeycomb or sweet oil, from the referenced spell

effect: Influences a creature through a short, reasonable-sounding spoken suggestion it understands.
conditions: An especially reasonable proposal may penalize its save at the referee’s discretion.
exceptions: Obvious self-destruction negates the suggestion; undead are unaffected.

spells.name: Confusion

fields.Material: Three nutshells, from the referenced magic-user spell
fields.Behavior roll: 01–10: wander away for 1 turn; 11–60: stand confused for 1 round; 61–80: attack nearest creature for 1 round; 81–00: attack caster/party for 1 round.

effect: Affects a base 2–16 creatures, plus any positive caster-level minus strongest-opponent-level/HD difference. Nearest eligible creatures are affected first.
conditions: Uses the magic-user spell’s 2–16 base count, not the druid spell’s 2–8. Save and action are checked each round; wandering lasts a full turn.

spells.name: Dispel Exhaustion

fields.Area: 1–4 persons touched during the casting round

effect: Temporarily restores 50% of lost hp by making recipients feel healthy and refreshed. They may move at double speed for 1 round each turn.
exceptions: At expiry they return to their actual hp; the apparent recovery is not permanent healing.

spells.name: Emotion
effect: Choose fear, hate, hopelessness or rage. Fear uses the fear effect; hopelessness uses its symbol effect.
Hate gives +2 morale, saves, to-hit and damage. Rage gives +1 to hit, +3 damage and +5 temporary hp, with reckless shieldless fighting.
conditions: Fear and rage counter each other; hate and hopelessness counter each other.
exceptions: The PHB does not specify whether the hopelessness reference means the cleric or magic-user Symbol; their descriptions differ.

spells.name: Improved Invisibility
effect: Allows attacks, missiles and spell casting without ending invisibility.
conditions: An observant foe may attack a telltale shimmer at −4 to hit; the invisible recipient gains +4 on saving throws.

spells.name: Massmorph
effect: Disguises up to 10 willing, man-sized-or-smaller creatures per level as trees. Passing among or touching them does not reveal the illusion.
exceptions: Striking them reveals blood/damage. Unwilling creatures cannot be included. Caster may end it, or dispel magic removes it.

spells.name: Minor Creation

fields.Material: A tiny sample of the kind of vegetable material to create

effect: Creates a nonliving vegetable-material object, such as rope, wood or cloth, within the volume limit.
conditions: Object lasts only for the spell duration.

spells.name: Phantasmal Killer

fields.Saving throw: Special: one 3d6 roll at or below Intelligence
fields.Disbelief modifiers: Complete surprise +2; surprise +1; previous attacks by this spell −1 each; illusionist −2; helm of telepathy −3 and possible reflection.

effect: Only caster and victim see the feared apparition. It attacks as a 4-HD monster; a hit kills from fright. It ignores barriers and is immune to attacks.
conditions: Only one disbelief attempt is allowed. Check magic resistance first; applicable racial spell resistance subtracts 1–5 from the dice, then subtract the Wisdom bonus from the 3d6 Intelligence check.
Slaying or rendering the caster unconscious ends it. A successful disbeliever with a helm of telepathy can turn it on the caster.
exceptions: Range is withheld because the OCR fraction is ambiguous.

spells.name: Shadow Monsters

fields.Area: 2″ × 2″; total normal HD up to caster level

effect: Creates one kind of semi-real monster with 20% of its normal rolled hp. Believers face its normal AC and attack forms.
Successful disbelievers face AC 10 monsters dealing only 20% normal melee damage.
conditions: All monsters from the casting must be the same kind.
exceptions: The source uses an unusual 0.4 fractional-rounding rule; its full application is not restated here.

spells.name: Chaos

fields.Saving throw: Special: only specified types receive saves
fields.Material: A small bronze disc and iron rod
fields.Behavior roll: 01–10: wander away for 1 turn; 11–60: stand confused for 1 round; 61–80: attack nearest creature for 1 round; 81–00: attack caster/party for 1 round.

effect: Confuses all creatures in the area using the druid confusion behavior.
conditions: Saves are allowed only to fighters other than paladins/rangers, illusionists, and non-spell-using monsters with Intelligence 4 or less.
exceptions: Range is withheld because its OCR fraction is ambiguous.

spells.name: Demi-Shadow Monsters
effect: Uses shadow monsters with 40% normal hp and damage potential, and AC 8 for the quasi-real version faced by disbelievers.
conditions: Same-kind and total-HD limits follow shadow monsters; believers face its normal apparent combat capability.
exceptions: Inherited fractional-rounding details remain a source lookup.

spells.name: Major Creation

fields.Duration: 6 turns/level for mineral objects; 12 turns/level for vegetable objects
fields.Material: A sample of the material, following minor creation

effect: Extends minor creation to mineral objects while doubling duration for vegetable objects.

spells.name: Maze

fields.Time trapped: Int <3: 2–8 turns; 3–5: 1–4 turns; 6–8: 5–20 rounds; 9–11: 4–16 rounds; 12–14: 3–12 rounds; 15–17: 2–8 rounds; 18+: 1–4 rounds.

effect: Sends the target wandering in an extradimensional labyrinth for the Intelligence-dependent period.
exceptions: Minotaurs are immune. Range is withheld because the OCR fraction is ambiguous.

spells.name: Projected Image

fields.Material: A small doll/replica of the caster

effect: Creates an intangible duplicate that performs the caster’s chosen actions. Spells cast through its special channel originate at the image.
conditions: The image must remain in the caster’s view; blocked sight ends it. Attacks do not harm it; dispel magic or the caster can dismiss it.
exceptions: Illusionist range is withheld because its header fraction is ambiguous.

spells.name: Shadow Door
effect: Makes the caster seem to enter a door and vanish while actually slipping aside invisibly. Opening the false door appears to reveal an empty room.
exceptions: True seeing, a gem of seeing or similar magic can find the caster.

spells.name: Shadow Magic
effect: Imitates magic missile, fireball, lightning bolt or cone of cold as quasi-real magic. Failed saves produce normal effects; successful saves reduce damage to 1 hp per caster level.

spells.name: Summon Shadow
effect: Conjures one shadow per 3 caster levels, controlled by the caster and attacking enemies on command.
conditions: Shadows remain until slain, turned or the duration ends.
exceptions: Monster statistics require the Monster Manual; no unsupported stat block is supplied.

spells.name: Conjure Animals

fields.Area: Mammals with total HD no greater than caster level

effect: Summons mammals that attack the caster’s opponents, using the cleric conjure animals procedure.
conditions: Each +1 hp in a creature’s HD expression counts as ¼ HD for the limit.

spells.name: Demi-Shadow Magic
effect: Extends shadow magic with wall of fire, wall of ice and cloudkill. Failed disbelief uses normal spell effects.
conditions: Against successful disbelievers, missile/fireball/bolt/cold effects deal 2 hp/level; walls deal 1–4 hp/level; cloudkill kills only creatures below 2 HD.

spells.name: Mass Suggestion

fields.Material: Snake’s tongue plus honeycomb or sweet oil, from suggestion

effect: Gives the same reasonable-sounding spoken suggestion to all recipients, using suggestion’s language, safety and undead restrictions.
conditions: All recipients must be within range. A single target saves at −2.

spells.name: Permanent Illusion
effect: Creates a lasting spectral force, including visual, sound, smell and temperature illusion, without concentration.
conditions: Dispel magic can remove it.
exceptions: The entry does not specify its material item; no component is invented here.

spells.name: Programmed Illusion

fields.Duration: Triggered illusion lasts up to 1 round/level

effect: Sets a spectral-force illusion to activate on command or a specified condition.
exceptions: Its material item is not specified in the entry and is not invented here.

spells.name: Shades
effect: Strengthens the shadow-monster family to 60% normal hp and damage potential, with AC 6 for the quasi-real version faced by disbelievers.
conditions: Same-kind and total-HD limits follow shadow monsters.
exceptions: Inherited fractional-rounding details remain a source lookup.

spells.name: True Sight
effect: Reveals actual or former forms and penetrates the deceptions described under true seeing.
exceptions: Unlike cleric true seeing, it does not reveal alignment.

spells.name: Veil
effect: Instantly changes the apparent surroundings or party, including hallucinatory terrain, and makes touch conform to the illusion.
conditions: Intelligent contact does not dispel terrain created this way.
exceptions: True seeing/sight, a gem of seeing or similar magic can penetrate it.

spells.name: Alter Reality
effect: Makes a limited alteration of reality, following limited wish’s literal, partial or temporary scope.
conditions: Requires depicting the intended alteration with phantasmal force plus limited verbal expression before the effect occurs.
exceptions: Does not simply grant requested wealth/XP or rewrite major realities. Results depend heavily on precise wording.

spells.name: Astral Spell

fields.Area: Caster and up to 5 linked fellow travelers

effect: Projects an astral body while the physical body and ordinary possessions remain behind. Certain multiplanar magic items can accompany it.
Permits astral travel and access to the first levels of the Outer Planes; a second body cannot be formed on the Prime Material plane.
conditions: Travelers must link with the cleric in a circle; companions depend on the cleric and may be stranded.
The silver cord connects astral and material bodies; severing it kills both. The physical body must remain safe.
exceptions: Astral actions ordinarily affect only astral creatures. Dispel magic or destruction of the physical body can terminate the spell.

spells.name: Prismatic Spray

fields.Saving throw: Only the colors specified below allow saves
fields.Color effects: Red: 10 damage; orange: 20; yellow: 40 (no saves for these three). Green: poison save or death. Blue: petrification save or stone. Indigo: wand save or insanity. Violet: magic save or transport to another plane.
fields.Ray roll: d8: 1 red, 2 orange, 3 yellow, 4 green, 5 blue, 6 indigo, 7 violet; 8 means two rays, rolling twice and ignoring further 8s.

effect: Sends colored rays from the caster’s hand; each creature in the area is struck by the randomly determined ray or rays.
exceptions: Spray widths are withheld because their OCR fractions are ambiguous.

spells.name: Prismatic Wall

fields.Area: Up to 4 feet wide/level and 2 feet high/level
fields.Color effects: Red: 10 damage; orange: 20; yellow: 40 (no saves for these three). Green: poison save or death. Blue: petrification save or stone. Indigo: wand save or insanity. Violet: magic save or transport to another plane.
fields.Negation order: Red: cone of cold; orange: gust of wind; yellow: disintegrate; green: passwall; blue: magic missile; indigo: continual light; violet: dispel magic.

effect: Creates the prismatic sphere’s seven colored protections as a wall/curtain. Red stops nonmagical missiles; orange magical missiles; yellow poison/gas/petrification; green breath; blue detection/psionics; indigo spells; violet is a force barrier.
conditions: Layers must be destroyed in order. Only the caster can pass safely; creatures below 8 HD looking at the colors are blinded for 2–8 turns.
exceptions: A rod of cancellation destroys it. Crossing exposes the creature to the layers’ effects.

spells.name: Vision

fields.Material: A sacrifice valued by the caster and/or the invoked power
fields.2d6 result: 2–6: no answer and an imposed supernatural service; 7–9: minor, possibly unrelated vision; 10+: requested vision.

effect: Requests supernatural guidance from a chosen power.
conditions: Sacrifice quality modifies the roll: very precious +1, extremely precious +2, priceless/unique +3.

spells.name: First-level Magic-user Spells

fields.PHB p.100 listed spells: Affect Normal Fires; Burning Hands; Charm Person; Comprehend Languages; Enlarge; Erase; Feather Fall; Friends; Hold Portal; Magic Missile; Mending; Message; Nystul’s Magic Aura; Protection from Evil; Read Magic; Shield; Shocking Grasp; Sleep; Tenser’s Floating Disc; Unseen Servant.

effect: At illusionist level 14, this selection grants four spells from the listed first-level magic-user choices, with one more gained at each later level.
conditions: Spells must be sought and learned in the magic-user manner.
exceptions: PHB p.100 directs selection from its 20 named spells. The introductory note on p.94 instead says the seventh-level list includes all first-level magic-user spells; the sources conflict, so the referee must decide how to apply the broader statement.
The PHB describes taking four or more selected first-level spells as one seventh-level spell; it does not explain every preparation or slot edge case.
